# Soundtrack credits

- **Dark Synthwave** uses music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio. The pack contains edited, game-specific cues for the NeonLoop mod. [White Bat Audio license](https://whitebataudio.com/pages/license-agreement) · [White Bat Audio channel](https://www.youtube.com/@WhiteBatAudio)
- **Cinematic Sci-Fi** uses music by Scott Buckley, released under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). [Scott Buckley’s music library](https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/)
- **Noir Jazz** uses music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). See each track’s Creative Commons attribution and license at its source link. [Incompetech music catalog](https://www.incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html) · [Incompetech music licensing](https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/licenses/)

NeonLoop edited, looped, and level-adjusted the music for specific in-game cues. Track titles, original source links, and edit information are in `Effects/bin/MusicPack/<soundtrack>/CueCredits.tsv`. See **F10 → Music** for the soundtrack and composer names.
